readme: Elementum Design System Custom Elements Manifest

declarations.name: ElAccordion
declarations.description: Accordion container coordinating multiple or single disclosure expansion.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when active item changes: detail: { value, open }

declarations.name: ElAccordionItem
declarations.description: Accessible disclosure item for accordion panel.

declarations.name: ElAlertDialog
declarations.description: Modal confirmation dialog for destructive or high-impact actions.

declarations.name: ElAlert
declarations.description: Inline notification banner with contextual variants, dismissibility and icon slots.

events.name: dismiss
events.description: Emitted when user dismisses the alert.

declarations.name: ElAspectRatio
declarations.description: CLS-free container enforcing fixed aspect ratios for responsive media.

declarations.name: ElAutocomplete
declarations.description: Form-associated combobox component supporting static data arrays, remote URL queries with debouncing, flexible key mapping, and ARIA 1.2 accessibility.

events.name: select
events.description: Fired when an option is selected: detail: { item, value, label }

events.name: remove
events.description: Fired in multi-mode when a chip is removed: detail: { item, items, value }

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when value changes: detail: { value, label }

declarations.name: ElAvatar
declarations.description: User avatar with image fallback, automatic initials, and status indicator.

declarations.name: ElAvatarGroup
declarations.description: Clustered avatar stack with overlapping borders.

declarations.name: ElBadge
declarations.description: Minimal status indicator and notification badge.

declarations.name: ElBorderBeam
declarations.description: Luminous animated border ray highlight that circles any container perimeter.

declarations.name: ElBreadcrumb
declarations.description: Semantic navigation trail container with configurable separators.

declarations.name: ElBreadcrumbItem
declarations.description: Individual breadcrumb link or terminal item.

declarations.name: ElButton
declarations.description: Frameworkless, signal-driven button component with 1:1 Figma variant parity.

slots.name: prefix
slots.description: Icon or element placed before the label.

slots.name: suffix
slots.description: Icon or badge placed after the label.

events.name: click
events.description: Fired when user clicks the button.

declarations.name: ElCalendar
declarations.description: Standalone accessible calendar month-grid component.

declarations.name: ElCallout
declarations.description: ElCallout Web Component (<el-callout>).

declarations.name: ElCard
declarations.description: Structured card container with header, title, description, content and footer subcomponents.

declarations.name: ElCarousel
declarations.description: Accessible touch-swipeable and keyboard navigable carousel with autoplay and indicators.

declarations.name: ElChart
declarations.description: Zero-dependency native SVG chart primitive with area, bar, line modes, reactive tooltips, and token theming.

declarations.name: ElCheckboxCard
declarations.description: ElCheckboxCard Web Component (<el-checkbox-card>).

declarations.name: ElCheckbox
declarations.description: Form-associated accessible checkbox with indeterminate tri-state support.

declarations.name: ElChip
declarations.description: Interactive pill / tag chip supporting selection, dismiss buttons, and slot icons.

events.name: remove
events.description: Fired when remove button is clicked: detail: { value }

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when selection toggles: detail: { selected, value }

declarations.name: ElCodeBlock
declarations.description: ElCodeBlock Web Component (<el-code-block>).

declarations.name: ElCollapsible
declarations.description: Accessible disclosure panel with smooth animated height expansion.

declarations.name: ElCommand
declarations.description: Accessible keyboard-first command menu and search palette (⌘K / cmdk style).

events.name: select
events.description: Fired when an item is selected: detail: { value, item }

declarations.name: ElCommandItem
declarations.description: ElCommandItem Web Component (<el-command-item>).

declarations.name: ElCommandGroup
declarations.description: ElCommandGroup Web Component (<el-command-group>).

declarations.name: ElContextMenu
declarations.description: Floating context menu opening at cursor coordinates on right-click.

declarations.name: ElDataList
declarations.description: ElDataList Web Component (<el-data-list>).

declarations.name: ElDataListItem
declarations.description: ElDataListItem Web Component (<el-data-list-item>).

declarations.name: ElDatepicker
declarations.description: Form-associated composite Datepicker combining dropdown, input, and calendar.

declarations.name: ElDialog
declarations.description: Accessible modal dialog powered by native <dialog> with overscroll containment.

declarations.name: ElDiffViewer
declarations.description: ElDiffViewer Web Component (<el-diff-viewer>).

declarations.name: ElDrawer
declarations.description: Accessible slide-over drawer panel with backdrop light-dismiss and keyboard traps.

declarations.name: ElDropdown
declarations.description: Accessible overlay container with light-dismiss and trigger slot.

declarations.name: ElDropzone
declarations.description: Drag and drop file upload target with type filtering and size constraint validation.

events.name: files-selected
events.description: Emitted when valid files are dropped or selected.

declarations.name: ElEmptyState
declarations.description: Zero-data placeholder graphic with title, description, and action CTA slots.

declarations.name: ElField
declarations.description: Accessible form field wrapper providing label, description, and error messaging.

declarations.name: ElForm
declarations.description: Form container orchestrating validation, serialization and data collection across Elementum inputs.

declarations.name: ElFieldset
declarations.description: Accessible field grouping container with legend and cascade disable support.

declarations.name: ElInput
declarations.description: Form-associated text/form input with prefix/suffix slots and design token styling.

declarations.name: ElInset
declarations.description: ElInset Web Component (<el-inset>).

declarations.name: ElInsightCard
declarations.description: ElInsightCard Web Component (<el-insight-card>).

declarations.name: ElKbd
declarations.description: Keycap keyboard shortcut parser and badge renderer.

declarations.name: ElMenubar
declarations.description: Desktop application menubar with arrow key roving focus and hover switching.

declarations.name: ElMeter
declarations.description: Scalar gauge primitive for displaying storage, CPU, and threshold metrics.

declarations.name: ElNavbar
declarations.description: ElNavbar Web Component (<el-navbar>).

declarations.name: ElNavigationMenu
declarations.description: ElNavigationMenu Web Component (<el-navigation-menu>).

declarations.name: ElNavigationMenuItem
declarations.description: ElNavigationMenuItem Web Component (<el-navigation-menu-item>).

declarations.name: ElNavigationMenuTrigger
declarations.description: ElNavigationMenuTrigger Web Component (<el-navigation-menu-trigger>).

declarations.name: ElNavigationMenuContent
declarations.description: ElNavigationMenuContent Web Component (<el-navigation-menu-content>).

declarations.name: ElNumberField
declarations.description: Precision numeric stepper with keyboard arrow scrubbing and bounds.

declarations.name: ElNumberFlow
declarations.description: Smooth vertical rolling odometer number reel with prefix/suffix support and reduced-motion fallback.

declarations.name: ElOtpInput
declarations.description: Segmented one-time-password and PIN verification box with auto-advance, backspace retreat, and paste splitting.

events.name: complete
events.description: Fired when all code slots are filled: detail: { value }

events.name: change
events.description: Fired on code change: detail: { value }

declarations.name: ElPagination
declarations.description: Accessible pagination component with dynamic page windowing, ellipsis, and W3C navigation semantics.

events.name: pagechange
events.description: Fired when page changes: detail: { page, pageSize }

declarations.name: ElPopover
declarations.description: Non-modal floating overlay anchored to a trigger with light-dismiss.

declarations.name: ElPreviewCard
declarations.description: Hover card popup showing rich preview content with hover intent delays.

declarations.name: ElProgress
declarations.description: Accessible progress bar with determinate and indeterminate states and WCAG role='progressbar'.

declarations.name: ElPromptInput
declarations.description: Auto-expanding AI prompt composer with action bar slots and Enter-to-submit keyboard shortcuts.

events.name: submit
events.description: Fired when prompt is submitted via Enter or submit button: detail: { value }

declarations.name: ElRadioCard
declarations.description: ElRadioCard Web Component (<el-radio-card>).

declarations.name: ElRadioCardGroup
declarations.description: ElRadioCardGroup Web Component (<el-radio-card-group>).

declarations.name: ElRadio
declarations.description: Accessible radio button primitive working inside ElRadioGroup.

declarations.name: ElRadioGroup
declarations.description: ElRadioGroup Web Component (<el-radio-group>).

declarations.name: ElRating
declarations.description: Form-associated star rating component with keyboard arrows and hover preview.

events.name: change
events.description: Emitted when rating value is confirmed.

declarations.name: ElReasoningCard
declarations.description: Collapsible AI thinking process disclosure with pulsing indicator dot and duration timer badge.

events.name: toggle
events.description: Fired when disclosure toggles: detail: { open }

declarations.name: ElResizable
declarations.description: Split-pane divider handle with pointer dragging and keyboard arrow resize.

events.name: resize
events.description: Emitted during pane resizing with percentage size.

declarations.name: ElResizableHandle
declarations.description: ElResizableHandle Web Component (<el-resizable-handle>).

declarations.name: ElResizablePanel
declarations.description: ElResizablePanel Web Component (<el-resizable-panel>).

declarations.name: ElRoute
declarations.description: ElRoute Web Component (<el-route>).

declarations.name: ElRouteLink
declarations.description: ElRouteLink Web Component (<el-route-link>).

declarations.name: ElRouter
declarations.description: ElRouter Web Component (<el-router>).

declarations.name: ElScrollArea
declarations.description: Custom cross-browser scrollbar container avoiding OS layout shifts.

declarations.name: ElSegmentedControl
declarations.description: Form-associated pill segment switcher with arrow key navigation and ARIA radiogroup semantics.

declarations.name: ElSelect
declarations.description: Form-associated custom select dropdown with option list.

declarations.name: ElSeparator
declarations.description: Visual or semantic horizontal/vertical content divider.

declarations.name: ElSidebar
declarations.description: Collapsible application sidebar with off-canvas drawer mode and responsive collapse.

declarations.name: ElSkeleton
declarations.description: Shimmer wave/pulse placeholder box preventing layout shifts.

declarations.name: ElSlider
declarations.description: Accessible continuous or stepped range slider with keyboard navigation.

declarations.name: ElSources
declarations.description: ElSources Web Component (<el-sources>).

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether full source cards are expanded (preferred alias for expanded)

declarations.name: ElSpinner
declarations.description: Smooth SVG loading spinner with accessible status role.

declarations.name: ElStreamingText
declarations.description: Simulated token-by-token streaming typewriter text with organic jitter, blinking cursor, and completion events.

events.name: stream-end
events.description: Fired when streaming completes: detail: { text }

events.name: stream-tick
events.description: Fired on each character token: detail: { text }

declarations.name: ElSwitch
declarations.description: Form-associated accessible toggle switch with keyboard support and token styling.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired on toggle: detail: { checked, value }

declarations.name: ElTable
declarations.description: Fine-grained reactive data table with column sorting and row selection.

attributes.name: filter
attributes.description: Case-insensitive search query that filters rows and highlights matching substrings in <mark part="highlight">.

attributes.name: highlight-only
attributes.description: Highlight matches for filter without removing non-matching rows (for server-side filtered data).

events.name: sort
events.description: Fired when sort column changes: detail: { key, direction }

events.name: selectionchange
events.description: Fired when row selection changes: detail: { selected }

declarations.name: ElTabs
declarations.description: Accessible tablist and tab panel container with keyboard navigation.

declarations.name: ElTab
declarations.description: Individual tab panel inside <el-tabs>.

declarations.name: ElTaskList
declarations.description: ElTaskList Web Component (<el-task-list>).

declarations.name: ElTextarea
declarations.description: Form-associated auto-resizing multi-line text input with character counting.

declarations.name: ElThemeSwitch
declarations.description: Color theme toggle between Light and Dark mode with localStorage persistence.

declarations.name: ElTimeline
declarations.description: Activity progression trail container.

declarations.name: ElTimelineItem
declarations.description: Individual chronological milestone node with status badges.

declarations.name: ElToaster
declarations.description: Viewport overlay container rendering programmatic toast notifications.

declarations.name: ElToast
declarations.description: Individual notification toast item managed by ToastManager.

declarations.name: ElToggle
declarations.description: Two-state toggle button with pressed state and group support.

declarations.name: ElToggleGroup
declarations.description: ElToggleGroup Web Component (<el-toggle-group>).

declarations.name: ElToolCall
declarations.description: ElToolCall Web Component (<el-tool-call>).

declarations.name: ElToolbar
declarations.description: Accessible action bar container with roving tabindex keyboard navigation.

declarations.name: ElTooltip
declarations.description: Accessible lightweight tooltip anchored to wrapped trigger element.

declarations.name: ElTreeView
declarations.description: Hierarchical tree list container with keyboard navigation.

declarations.name: ElTreeItem
declarations.description: Expandable/collapsible tree node.

declarations.name: ElVisuallyHidden
declarations.description: ElVisuallyHidden Web Component (<el-visually-hidden>).

declarations.name: ElShimmerText
declarations.description: Animated light-sweep sheen across status or AI thinking text with solid WCAG contrast.

declarations.name: ElHoldButton
declarations.description: Press-and-hold confirmation button for deliberate actions with pointer and keyboard fill progress.

events.name: confirm
events.description: Fired when hold finishes: detail: { duration }

events.name: cancel
events.description: Fired when released early: detail: { progress }

declarations.name: ElUsageRing
declarations.description: Segmented SVG radial quota meter with tabular numerals and accessible progressbar semantics.

declarations.name: ElActivityGrid
declarations.description: 7-row activity heatmap matrix with keyboard arrow navigation and semantic intensity levels.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: Optional JSON array of { date, count, level } entries

events.name: select
events.description: Fired when a cell is clicked: detail: { index, date, count, level }
